detectiveClues.clueText: Born in **1241** so tiny and fragile that priests rushed to baptize her immediately—prophesying *"This little baby will NOT die; she will become a great saint!"*—joyful **Mechtilde of Hackeborn** visited her older sister’s convent at age **seven** and loved its music, books, and laughter so much she begged her parents to let her stay! Growing up at **Helfta Abbey**, she became the abbey’s beloved **Choir Director (*Domna Cantrix*) and Head Schoolteacher**—earning the enchanting nickname ***"The Nightingale of Helfta!"***
